responsibility: Defines the IQ2000 target’s machine-description operand constraints used by reload, instruction recognition, and asm operand validation. It assigns register classes to constraint letters and classifies immediates and memory forms that the backend can encode directly, such as signed and unsigned 16-bit constants, split-loadable constants, special mask patterns, zero FP constants, and single-word simple memory references, providing the constraint vocabulary consumed by iq2000.md patterns.
